description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix with haste.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
